title: Research: shared-dirt partitioned 8q priced obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Freestanding `#840`-style priced obstruction under [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`. Names a **fourth** dirt-legal readout alphabet at `Q=8` beyond same-walk / dirty-shadow / partitioned dual / one-repeat / two-repeat: **shared-dirt** (joint even live-read parity) dual on distinct partitioned walks. Soft-overlap-safe vs deferred shared-XOR (R-side dirt coupling only).

| Dual schedule | Covering pairs | Exact min R | Tariff floor (X≥0) | Undercuts 436? | Beats independent floors? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Independent `(2,6)` (#2851) | 3916416 | **92** | ≥488 | no | — |
| Shared-dirt `(2,6)` (this) | 3916416 | **82** | **≥468** | **no** | **yes** |
| Independent `(3,5)` (#2851) | 10416000 | **98** | ≥500 | no | — |
| Shared-dirt `(3,5)` (this) | 10416000 | **82** | **≥468** | **no** | **yes** |
| Independent `(4,4)` (#2851) | 14165760 | **100** | ≥504 | no | — |
| Shared-dirt `(4,4)` (this) | 14165760 | **82** | **≥468** | **no** | **yes** |

Global shared-dirt min is `R=82` (spectra include 82/88/96). Abstract tariff `38·8+2·82=468>436`. Undercuts independent-dirt floors but not the six-query endpoint.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2861) / [#2860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2860) / [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858) / [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/shared-dirt-walks-8q/`.
Tip: `fc3a2cb3362934b1e34df974e64f9d0acfe07b77`.

Exact: partition min R **82** (tariff floor **468**); no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-dirt-walks-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/shared-dirt-walks-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-dirt-walks-8q/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/shared-dirt-walks-8q/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shared-dirt-walks-8q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SHARED_DIRT_WALKS_8Q_OBSTRUCTION partition_min_R=82 ... tariff_floor=468 ... soft_overlap_shared_xor_safe no_new_kappa
PASS_SHARED_DIRT_WALKS_8Q covering_26=3916416 ... partition_min_R=82 tariff_floor=468 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_SHARED_DIRT_WALKS_8Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/shared-dirt-walks-8q outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.
